skills.detail:
Creates a marker at close-range that only you can see.
The marker can be moved while the skill button is held down.
Reduces chance of getting pushed away when attacked by enemy while the skill is active.

You will be moved to the marker's location and the marker will disappear after a certain period of time or when the skill button is released.
Also, deals a mid-range area attack.

Deals increased damage to Attackers.
Damage dealt will disregard damage reduction.
Become temporarily invincible after use.
Acquires ATK debuff effect at Level 5.
skills.name: Pipe Down, You Insects!

skills.detail:
When your team's Treasure Area is being captured:
Moves to your team's closest Treasure Area that is being captured by the enemy.
Increases own ATK.
A long-range area attack with a Knockback effect.

When your team's Treasure Area is not being captured:
Increases own ATK.
A long-range area attack with a Knockback effect.

Damage dealt will disregard damage reduction.
Attack ignores obstacles.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
